items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: I could go out and pick up Rosier Grady... from a little number that taught me from the company.

ctx.x: Yeah. I couldn't take any lessons.

I couldn't take any lessons. I'm pretty sure I didn't have no more than five or six. But I could go out and pick up Rosier Grady, take East Side, West Side, from a little number that taught me from the company. And I finally jumped around the piano and went down the bass and later on I found augments and diminishes and all that kind of stuff. It come to me natural. See? Well I go back to Mila Coma again, twice. I couldn't stay away with rice and beans and good gumbo and good fine oysters that fifteen cents a…
What year did you get here first? 1910.
